facts.label: Passivo presente
facts.sub: Use is/are + particípio para processos, nomes, materiais e usos: A form is filled in. It is called a debit card. It is made of plastic.

facts.label: Processo
facts.sub: Para explicar um processo, use is/are + particípio: A form is filled in. Your passport is checked. Não é preciso dizer quem faz a ação.

facts.label: Nome
facts.sub: Para dar o nome de algo, use is called: It is called a debit card. Para perguntar, diga What is this called? Em PT é “como se chama”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The passive uses is/are + past participle.
We say “The card is sent by mail”.
We say “It is make of plastic”.
items.why: We say It is made of plastic.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The passive uses is/are + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes: is checked, is kept.)
We say “The card is sent by mail”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It is make of plastic”. → Falso (We say It is made of plastic.)

pages.title: A busy bank · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot morning in a bank in Miami. Cool air comes from the ceiling. Dan walks to the front desk with his passport. His friend Elena is the bank clerk. She wears a gray jacket. She smiles at him.
“Good morning, Dan! How can I help you today?” says Elena. “I’d like to open an account. How is it opened?” says Dan. “First, a form is filled in. Then your passport is checked.” says Elena.
